script.problem: The card's right answer is "death", but the new right answer is "Until the high priest died". Keep the same right answer.

haiku.problem: The wrong answers "Until the high priest spoke" and "Until the high priest blessed him" are silly compared with the right answer, so the right answer stands out. Replace them with answers in the same plain tone as "Until the high priest died", such as "Until the offerings were finished" or "Until the elders gave permission".
